stock.description: Concord Healthcare Group Co., Ltd. is dedicated to providing comprehensive cancer treatment services for patients and healthcare institutions throughout China. Its operations extend beyond direct care to include the distribution and installation of medical hardware and software, along with offering management and technical assistance, and providing equipment via operating leases. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. It functions as a subsidiary of Shanghai Medstar Financial Leasing Company.
